vulnerability_families.detail: Devices that rely on Just Works pairing increase impersonation and silent pairing risk.
Repeated bond churn or silent pairing flows suggest weak trust lifecycle handling.
Writable or control-plane characteristics without strong authorization enable practical impact.
Bluetooth stacks and chipset families can inherit known weakness classes or delayed patch uptake.
Accessory pairing ecosystems can permit unauthorized ownership transfer or silent trust abuse.
Input peripherals can become keystroke-injection or reconnect-impersonation targets if trust flows are weak.
Persistent identifiers, ecosystem service UUIDs, and wearable/tracker roles create tracking and privacy risk.
